extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Intuitive notion of value approached as input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change defined by a limit.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence of derivative at a point; implies continuity.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g ≤ f ≤ h and outer limits equal L, then limit of f is L.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(x^n) = nx^{n-1}.

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Second, third, and nth derivatives such as f'' and f^{(n)}.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, lim f/g = lim f'/g'.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(c) = [f(b)-f(a)]/(b-a) for some c.

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous function on [a,b] has absolute max/min.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where derivative is zero or undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classifies critical points using sign changes of f'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses f'(c)=0 and f''(c) to classify local extrema.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'' > 0 concave up; f'' < 0 concave down.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maximum or minimum subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Left, right, or midpoint approximation to area.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit of Riemann sums representing accumulated change.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects definite integrals with antiderivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration by Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u-substitution, chain rule in reverse.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives, such as dy/dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of dy/dx for a differential equation.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solves ODEs by integrating separated variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Average Value of a Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f_avg = (1/(b-a))∫_a^b f(x)dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms; may converge or diverge.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converges if lim |a_{n+1}/a_n| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power series using derivatives to approximate a function.

MVT requires differentiability on the open interval.

The test classifies critical points.
The test uses concavity to classify extrema.
Concavity is determined by the second derivative.
Optimization uses derivatives to locate extrema.
Newton's method uses f'(x_n) in its iteration.

Substitution is described as the chain rule in reverse.
A slope field visualizes dy/dx.
